decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void, preventing them from casting their spells effectively. This disruption allows the aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers to push through damage and end the game quickly. With acceleration from Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, as well as powerful removal like Fury and Sundering Eruption, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 Aggro deck focuses on maximizing damage output while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck includes cards like Lightning Bolt, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Delver of Secrets to apply pressure early on. It also utilizes cards like Force of Will and Daze for disruption and protection. Canadian Threshold aims to control the board with efficient spells like Unholy Heat and Murktide Regent, while utilizing tempo plays with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, this deck aims to quickly close out games through aggressive plays and disruptive tactics.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares for disruption, as well as creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard to search for key pieces, the deck aims to establish early dominance in the game and maintain pressure throughout. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the overall strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing Aether Vial to efficiently deploy creatures and disrupt opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and removal like Swords to Plowshares. It also emphasizes a strong creature toolbox with cards like Recruiter of the Guard to search for key pieces like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Baleful Strix. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its three-color Esper configuration, allowing for access to powerful spells like Teferi, Time Raveler and Lórien Revealed. Additionally, the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides a powerful value engine for the deck.

The deck focuses on quickly casting a large number of spells to win the game by milling the opponent's entire library and using Thassa's Oracle to win the game by revealing no cards left in the library. It uses cards like Lotus Petal, Simian Spirit Guide, and Dark Ritual to power out its combo pieces quickly, while also using cards like Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy for protection and disruption. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn while preventing the opponent from interacting with the combo.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Hymn to Tourach, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. It seeks to maintain tempo advantage through cards like Daze and Force of Will, while deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf to apply pressure and win the game quickly. The deck also utilizes Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to draw cards and provide card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive, disruptive, and versatile in controlling the pace of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures using cards like Faithless Looting and Careful Study, then utilize cards like Dread Return and Bridge from Below to bring back powerful creatures such as Golgari Grave-Troll and Thassa's Oracle. By using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Darkblast, the deck can efficiently combo off and win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, using cards like Entomb and Animate Dead. By utilizing a combination of reanimation spells and disruptive cards like Daze and Thoughtseize, you aim to cheat big threats into play ahead of schedule and overwhelm your opponent. The deck also includes tempo elements like Brazen Borrower and Wasteland to disrupt your opponent's game plan while you set up your combo. Overall, this deck focuses on a fast and powerful graveyard-based strategy to win the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with high-cost creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand, then using efficient reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play for a low cost. It also utilizes disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to control the game and protect its combo pieces. The goal is to set up a powerful board state early in the game and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play using cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. The deck also utilizes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and The One Ring to provide additional support and protection. With the help of cards like Ponder and Brainstorm for card selection and manipulation, and Force of Will and Flusterstorm for disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent with its combo potential.

The deck revolves around cheating out powerful creatures such as Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn through cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It also utilizes the combo of Atraxa, Grand Unifier and The One Ring to generate infinite mana. The deck includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its key cards, along with card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces. With the help of cards like Omniscience, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its big threats.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp to fuel powerful graveyard interactions. Utilizing cards like Bridge from Below and Dread Return, the deck aims to generate an overwhelming board presence by casting spells from the graveyard. Cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Cabal Therapy help to facilitate this game plan, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Poxwalkers and Narcomoeba provide additional ways to generate value from the graveyard, ultimately leading to a powerful combo finish with cards like Thassa's Oracle.

The main strategy of this deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Lightning Bolt, Force of Will, and Daze while quickly building up pressure with fast creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to maintain tempo by clearing the way with Wasteland and countering key spells with Force of Negation. Canadian Threshold utilizes a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells to apply pressure and control the game, ultimately overwhelming the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a powerful 20/20 flying indestructible creature token in order to win the game. The deck includes various ways to search for and protect these key combo pieces, such as Green Sun's Zenith, Crop Rotation, and Knight of the Reliquary. Additionally, the deck also includes disruptive elements like Gaddock Teeg and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to slow down opponents while the combo is set up.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly lower your own life total to maximize the power of Death's Shadow while disrupting your opponent's game plan with hand disruption and countermagic. The Aggro strategy is to put pressure on your opponent while also controlling the board with removal spells and bounce effects. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and can help dig for key cards. The deck aims to be proactive and efficient, while also being able to adapt to different matchups with its versatile card choices.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then using reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful advantage. Careful Study, Thoughtseize, and Ponder help to dig through the deck and find the necessary combo pieces, while Force of Will and Daze provide protection against opposing disruption. Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Valgavoth, Terror Eater offer additional utility and threats to overwhelm the opponent. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficient reanimation and disruptive control elements to secure a win.
